step1_analysis.description: This subcircuit consists of three diode-connected transistors (two PMOS, one NMOS) acting as a voltage divider or bias generator. It establishes a reference voltage at node N0 based on the voltages provided at LABEL_NET_0 and LABEL_NET_1, likely used for biasing the match-line driver or sense amplifier in the CAM macro.

paper_reference.title: A Design for High-Speed Low-Power CMOS Fully Parallel Content-Addressable Memory Macros

Energy_per_operation.description: Energy consumed per search operation (applies to full CAM macro)

sky130_expected.calculation: Not directly measurable on this isolated DC subcircuit. For the full macro, scaling from 0.35um/3.3V to 0.13um/1.8V yields approx 131fJ * (0.13/0.35) * (1.8/3.3)^2.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Capacitance scales with feature size, and energy scales with VDD^2.

Search_Delay.description: Search access time (applies to full CAM macro)

sky130_expected.calculation: Not applicable to this DC bias subcircuit.
sky130_expected.reasoning: 130nm process is significantly faster than 350nm, reducing gate delays.

V_N0_DC.description: DC bias voltage established at node N0

sky130_expected.calculation: With inputs at 0.9V, the PMOS (S=0.9V) and NMOS (S=0V) are diode-connected. To balance currents, they operate in subthreshold. V_N0 will settle near V_input / 2.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on the exact subthreshold leakage balance between the SKY130 PMOS and NMOS devices.

Static_Power.description: Static power consumption of the bias circuit

sky130_expected.calculation: P = V * I_subthreshold. Since Vgs < Vth for all devices when inputs are 0.9V, current is in the nA range.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Diode-connected devices with low source voltages draw minimal subthreshold leakage.

Sensitivity.description: Change in output voltage N0 per 1V change in input LABEL_NET_0

sky130_expected.calculation: Small signal voltage divider between the transconductances of XM1, XM2, and XM3.
sky130_expected.reasoning: XM1 and XM3 are in parallel opposing XM2. The exact ratio depends on their relative gm in subthreshold.

step3_testbench.description: Measures the DC operating point (bias voltage and static power) and performs a DC sweep to determine the sensitivity of the bias node to input variations.
step3_testbench.spice:
* CAM Bias Circuit Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u

XM1 N0 N0 LABEL_NET_0 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N0 N0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N0 N0 LABEL_NET_1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VLABEL_NET_0 LABEL_NET_0 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_1 LABEL_NET_1 0 0.9

.control
* 1. DC Operating Point for Bias Voltage and Power
op
print v(N0)
let static_power = -i(VVDD)*1.8 - i(VLABEL_NET_0)*0.9 - i(VLABEL_NET_1)*0.9
print static_power

* 2. DC Sweep for Sensitivity Analysis
dc VLABEL_NET_0 0 1.8 0.01
meas dc v_n0_at_0_9 find v(N0) at=0.9
meas dc v_n0_at_1_0 find v(N0) at=1.0
let sensitivity = (v_n0_at_1_0 - v_n0_at_0_9) / 0.1
print sensitivity

quit
.endc
.end
